title: Atari Gamma Force
tagline: A vertical shooter for the Atari 7800
ready: Press Z to start. Click or press a key for sound.
controls: [Z] and [X] together when the gauge is full
about: A demake of MegaGammaForce for the Picocomputer 6502: nine stages, from a fortress at sea to a flight low over the Sun, each with a boss taken apart piece by piece.
Two weapons: the Vulcan, and the Radiant Sword that cuts through enemies and absorbs pink bullets. Absorb 36 to charge the Hyper Sword. A color chain and weapon levels raise the score.
Three modes: EXPERT has all the enemy's fire, NORMAL about half, and TEDDY BEAR adds five ships with armor. The music is MegaGammaForce's, converted to POKEY.
